manifest.title_fil: Tumugon sa ubo at hirap sa paghinga
manifest.title_en: Respond to cough and breathing concerns
objectives_fil: Ilarawan ang paghinga, itanong ang danger signs, at gamitin ang kumpirmadong daan sa agarang pagsusuri.
objectives_en: Describe breathing observations, ask about danger signs and activate the confirmed urgent assessment route.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: Umuubo at tila hirap huminga si Aya, apat na taong gulang
sections.takeaway_en: Case: Four-year-old Aya coughs and appears to struggle for breath

sections.takeaway_fil: Ilarawan ang paghinga, itanong ang danger signs, at gamitin ang kumpirmadong daan sa agarang pagsusuri.
sections.takeaway_en: Describe breathing observations, ask about danger signs and activate the confirmed urgent assessment route.

sections.takeaway_fil: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong.

check.prompt_fil: Sa kasong ito, ano ang unang tugon?
check.prompt_en: In this case, what comes first?

options.fil: Maghintay muna at huwag ipaalam sa staff.
options.en: Wait without notifying the responsible staff.

options.fil: Gawin muna ang shortcut kahit walang kumpirmasyon.
options.en: Use the shortcut before confirming the facts.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring maantala ang kinakailangang assessment. 2: Maaaring makapinsala ang shortcut: Huwag umasa sa isang lumang bilang ng temperatura o paghinga, o ipangakong maaaring maghintay ang batang hirap huminga. 3: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong.
check.feedback_en: 1: Necessary assessment may be delayed. 2: The shortcut can cause harm: Do not use a single old temperature or respiratory-rate threshold as a stand-alone referral rule, or promise that a child with breathing difficulty can wait. 3: Prioritize safety and timely help.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ilarawan ang paghinga, itanong ang danger signs, at gamitin ang kumpirmadong daan sa agarang pagsusuri.
sections.takeaway_en: Describe breathing observations, ask about danger signs and activate the confirmed urgent assessment route.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang saklaw at kailangan sa tamang tao.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm boundaries and requirements with the appropriate person.

sections.takeaway_fil: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral.
sections.takeaway_en: Observe the task and appropriate referral.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang dapat ipakita sa practice?

options.fil: Magbigay ng diagnosis mula sa kuwento at mangakong sapat na iyon para sa pasyente.
options.en: Diagnose from the story and promise it is enough for the person.

options.fil: Ulitin ang shortcut kahit may panganib at walang kumpirmadong tagubilin.
options.en: Repeat the shortcut despite the risk and without confirmed guidance.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral. 2: Hindi batayan ang kuwento para sa sariling diagnosis. 3: Ang shortcut ay hindi ligtas: Huwag umasa sa isang lumang bilang ng temperatura o paghinga, o ipangakong maaaring maghintay ang batang hirap huminga.
check.feedback_en: 1: Observe the task and appropriate referral. 2: The story is not grounds for an independent diagnosis. 3: The shortcut is unsafe: Do not use a single old temperature or respiratory-rate threshold as a stand-alone referral rule, or promise that a child with breathing difficulty can wait.

sections.takeaway_fil: Subukan ang gawain at balikan ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Try the task and review the result.
